integration_points.role: Client negotiation/compression/reconstruction seam; preserve current credentials/account epoch/no-auto-retry.
Small server integration seam: negotiate session; authenticate+decode BEFORE submit; encode already bounded-page result opt-in.
Existing wire custody/ref/integrity; preserve custody before terminal yield and separate tail checkpoint. Do not replace with answer-wide buffer.
Actual inscriptions/semantic candidate and admission; reconstruction must happen before app_memory.begin; transport never prunes q/p.
New audio/video policy stays disabled; no codec negotiation grants media permission. Existing metadata GET remains scoped.
Reuse opaque scoped reference concepts, DPAPI custody and authoritative metadata checks; current store is audio/video-specific, not a generic image/PDF backend.
Provider boundary still receives complete supported original payload. Local refs/deflate do not reduce model tokens; provider protocol compression unsupported unless separately verified.
Existing route byte/auth/CSRF middleware is an invariant; proposed changes belong in register/client, not this large server file.

existing_engineering.app_wire_ref: Already avoids q text/meta/base64 copies for new provider wire; keep scoped read/hash validation and legacy data.
existing_engineering.jobs: Idempotency by canonical restored full body + owner; pagination already incremental by after cursor.256000characters is a target, not hard bytes limit for the first event.
existing_engineering.attachments: Opaque scoped refs/deletion/DPAPI exist for old AV. New AV remains disabled. Generic image/PDF dedupe is not currently enabled; separate encrypted scoped store adapter would be required.
existing_engineering.codec_names: Two distinct ACOM1 layouts. App uses fixed len/CRC/SHA/zlib; Central uses MAGIC+u32BE JSON header then payload. Neither is generically interchangeable.
existing_engineering.central_archive: ACOMARCH1 streaming archive, path safety,512MiB web caps and lzma/xz routes are useful archival engineering, not a browser-native low-latency chat wire.
not_used: luminidic atoms without exact residual preservation

protocol.known_state: Authenticated server advertises scoped immutable manifest roots. Client can delta only if local original base manifest matches root; receiver confirms before admission. Content hashes are integrity, never credentials.
protocol.manifest: Scope-key,exact raw object hash/length,ordered block(hash,length),version. References only allowed within declared authorized base; no global cache existence probe.
protocol.reconstruction: Bound every compressed block before expansion; verify single-stream EOF/length/CRC/SHA; enforce sequence/offset/root; spool bytes, never rewrite semantic history. Full request must validate before submit. Response blocks/pages may render provisionally but terminal acknowledgement only after validated terminal and custody.
protocol.idempotency: Transport retransmission/replay yields receipt only and never repeats provider execution. Existing job ledger remains authoritative for actual execution uncertainty.
protocol.missing_base: Fail no_dispatch_this_submission before submit. No fallback/retry coded. Next explicit send can be full. Optional RAM lease/reservation announced in session could remove GET/POST eviction race, but requires bounded quotas+expiry+crash semantics and independent review; not implemented.
protocol.stream: Prototype receives explicit end before EOF when response mode selected. Existing chat should compress each polling page, not buffer answer-wide SSE. Preserve R4 custody-before-yield.
protocol.limits: Prototype8MiB object/32KiB block/2KiB header is test policy only; cannot replace production chat20MiB and input document limits. Real integration needs measured decoded/wire/concurrency/cache/retention caps.

security.authentication: Trusted server account generation/conversation + current cookie/native bearer first. Do not accept scope from envelope as authority. Worker revalidates generation before dispatch.
security.csrf: Preserve existing origin/CSRF middleware. No new CORS headers: negotiation field and page query opt-in; no credentials included in compressed body/header copies.
security.hash: SHA256 raw bytes + manifest. Optional MAC would require existing authenticated server session mechanism; no new keys generated here. CRC is corruption check only.
security.cache: Partition by principal+generation+conversation; no cross-scope dedupe hints. Production at-rest custody must reuse approved encryption/auth/deletion/revocation controls. Isolated prototype SQLite/files are NOT production encrypted storage.
security.bounded_decode: Cap declared length before decompression; cap actual output,wire,frames,header,size/time/concurrency; reject duplicated JSON keys,nonfinite fields,unused compressed trailing data,unknown codecs/refs.
security.compression_context: Independent per object/page; never share secret-bearing dictionary across accounts. Prototype lacks network DoS/multiworker admission/encryption/quota/GC implementations.
security.no_dispatch_on_error: Decode/verify before store.submit/admit/wallet/reservation. A visible refusal describes only this submission, never the state of an earlier uncertain job.

comparison.gzip_HTTP: Best byte count on these repetitive text fixtures; no cache or custom manifest. Existing proxy/WSGI request Content-Encoding support not verified. Server must authenticate and cap decompression before request JSON; response middleware must not buffer SSE until complete.
comparison.JSON_deflate: Slightly larger base64 envelope but no new CORS/HTTP Content-Encoding requirement, negotiable at existing session GET. Safest small proposed patch after source-agent review: encode/decode actual POST and each existing result page independently, no base cache initially.
comparison.references: Warm refs save most bytes for already compressed/random repeated attachments; cold packet can grow33percent or more in JSON. Charge base setup and manifests. Need encrypted scoped authoritative generic attachment API for image/PDF reuse; do not repurpose AV endpoint or enable AV.
comparison.blocks: Fine-grained cache can preserve repeated byte prefixes but hash/chunk CPU,metadata and local reconstruction still cost. Fixed boundaries degrade under insertion and small writes. No semantic compression or model-token reduction.
comparison.selection: Count complete envelope+base64+manifest/advert. Emit compacted only if saving >=max(1024bytes,5percent). Raw/gzip/JSON/ref choices depend on negotiated capability and actual known base, never benchmark-only assumption.

where_time_saves.MEASURED: Local compression/decompression and protocol encode/spool/SQLite timings are separate; raw packet byte counts measured. No network/model latency measured. Decoder Python peaks approximately403k..449kbytes for these fixtures, excluding preallocated fixture/packet harness.
where_time_saves.DERIVED: Serialization time_ms=wire_bytes*8/(Mbps*1e6)*1000; benchmark includes2/10/50Mbps. E.g repeated-text full-body transfer can save seconds at2Mbps but no inferred improvement in model generation or tool time.
where_time_saves.not_saved: Provider still expands full supported messages/attachment bytes; model tokens/context/generation unchanged. Cryptography/probe/extraction and retries are separate bottlenecks. Reconstructing full history still uses CPU/memory locally.
where_time_saves.TTFB: Page compression waits only for existing page, not whole answer. Microframe flush overhead/RTT/proxy/browser/mobile support require later real deployment measurement.
